notes.title: Fantasy Maiden Wars - DREAM OF THE STRAY DREAMER - Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
[h3]We’ve released the demo for [i]Fantasy Maiden Wars - DREAM OF THE STRAY DREAMER -[/i], letting you experience the grand story’s opening three episodes while getting a taste of the full game’s gameplay.[/h3]

[b]As in the full game, you can freely choose your protagonist: the shrine maiden Reimu or the magician Marisa. Which perspective will you start your story from?


The full release of [i]Fantasy Maiden Wars - DREAM OF THE STRAY DREAMER -[/i] is just around the corner.
ー An epic journey awaits you!
Play the demo and get ready to embark on the adventure when the game launches.[/b]

notes.title: Release Date Confirmed! Coming to Steam - Oct 21(JST), 2025
notes.content:
[b]Mark your Calendars! We’re dropping Touhou Bullet Hell SRPG "Fantasy Maiden Wars - DREAM OF THE STRAY DREAMER -" on Steam: Oct 21 JST (20  PT) , 2025![/b]

[b]Select either Shrine Maiden Reimu and Marisa the Magician as Gensokyo’s savior, and embark on an epic journey across the original Touhou Project lore infused with story elements from fan creations.[/b]

[previewyoutube=ZGh85ILWdbU;full][/previewyoutube]
Fantasy Maiden Wars is a classic tactical RPG where you command a diverse cast of characters and battle your way through stage-based missions.
Set in Gensokyo, a world where humans, youkai, and gods coexist, you'll team up with over 70 unique allies to confront a series of supernatural incidents shaking the land.
[b]WISHLIST NOW!![/b]
